New for 2026: Animals are a part of this year’s event!
Animals are at the heart of everything we do at the Bronx Zoo! NEW for 2026, we’re opening the
Children’s Zoo Farmyard
for Holiday Lights, our beloved holiday tradition. Enjoy a festive moment with donkeys, sheep, goats, alpacas, and more in this cozy, picture-perfect backdrop!
For more special animal moments and extra warm-up spots, we’re keeping the
World of Darkness
and
World of Reptiles
open too, so you can hang with a sloth and bask with lizards as part of your Bronx Zoo nighttime adventure.
For even more animal magic, your Holiday Lights tickets now offer a
2- in-1 experience!
Arrive at 1 p.m. to spend time with your favorite animals, including snow leopards, tigers, and bears, and stay for the lights.
The Best of New York City’s Family Holiday Tradition
During Holiday Lights, the Bronx Zoo transforms into a magical, forested wonderland filled with stunning animal lanterns, enchanting moments, and festive delights! Each year, this celebratory nighttime experience draws families from across the tri-state area and beyond to connect and make precious memories together. With entertainment, delicious treats, and activities for everyone, Holiday Lights is packed with festive fun! This year, we’re adding an extra sprinkle of animal magic to the mix.
GET TICKETS
WCS Member Benefits
A Celebration in Lights
Lantern
Safaris
Travel through six immersive trails representing Africa, Asia, North America, Latin America, the Ocean, and the Forest of Color, and see hundreds of glorious animal lanterns depicting iconic animals from each region. Feel connected to the wildlife and wild places that WCS is working to protect around the world.
Iconic Light
Displays
Perfect for incredible photo ops with friends and family.
Holiday Tree
At the heart of the zoo, our stunning holiday tree features synchronized animal-themed musical light performances.
Astor Court
Light Tunnels
Dazzling walk-through light tunnels throughout the zoo create perfect holiday photo backdrops.
Around the Park
More Holiday Lights fun!
Play with Light
Draw, touch, and dance with light at interactive glowing walls, shimmering flowers, and colored stepping stones. Send virtual holiday cards to WCS conservation staff worldwide.
Dancing Crane Plaza
Illuminated Performers
Amazing animal-themed illuminated characters amp up the atmosphere and add a fun, festive twist to family photo ops.
Astor Court
Holiday Train
All aboard! Take a joyful spin around Fountain Circle on the kids’ Holiday Train!
$4 ($3 Members, FREE for Conservation-level Members)
Fountain Circle
Freeze Zone
Take an exhilarating ride on a snowtube slide, throw virtual snowballs, and get a cool photo op in the interactive Freeze Zone!
Giraffe Corner
Ice Carving Demonstrations
Watch in awe as ice sculptors create works of wildlife art from giant blocks of ice!
Grizzly Corner
Wildlife Theater
Performers and puppets present you with family-friendly animal adventures and wildlife trivia.
Dancing Crane Pavilion
Holiday
Treats & Drinks
Dial up the holiday cheer with cozy festive treats available for purchase, including hot chocolate, warm apple cider, eggnog, cookies, peppermint bark, pumpkin pie, s’mores, and so much mores! Adults can warm things up by spiking their seasonal drink with Irish Cream, Kahlúa, Whiskey, or Rum.
Throughout the Zoo
Even more
2 for 1
Holiday Fun
Come for the animals, stay for the lights! Arrive at the zoo at 1pm, and your Holiday Lights tickets allow you to enjoy a few hours with your favorite animals before the lights go on and the park transforms!
GET TICKETS
WCS Member Benefits
Tickets are required and must be reserved in advance. Changes to activity availability may occur due to unforeseen conditions. Holiday Lights is a rain or shine event.
Add a Wild Encounter to your Holiday Lights visit!
Wild Encounters are a great way to get up-close and personal with some of your favorite animals during the afternoon of your Holiday Lights visit. You could meet fennec foxes, camels, reptiles, and more!

Host your very own holiday party at the Bronx Zoo during our Holiday Lights celebration. Perfect for groups of any size.
Learn More
2026: November 21–22 and 27–29. December 3–6, 10–13, 17–23, 26–31. 2027: January 2–3. (December 3 is a
Sensory Friendly Night
with some modifications of the experiences.)
Holiday Lights operates 1pm to 9pm. Last entry into the park is at 8pm.
Holiday Lights tickets are open arrival from 1:00pm to 8:00pm.
Please note that the lights go on and lantern trails open at 4:30pm.
Tickets must be shown for park admission as well as for most lantern trails and Holiday Lights activities.
Bronx River and Southern Boulevard Gates are the ONLY gates open for Holiday Lights. Asia Gate and Fordham Road Gate are CLOSED for Holiday Lights. Asia Gate is closed for pedestrian exit at 2 pm.
Yes! We are pleased to offer a specific Sensory-Friendly Night on December 3, 2026 to provide an experience that is supportive of guests with sensory sensitivities. See details of program modifications on
the event page
, or contact
guestrelations@wcs.org
with additional questions.

Bronx Zoo accessibility webpage

New for 2026: Animals are a part of this year’s event!
Animals are at the heart of everything we do at the Bronx Zoo! NEW for 2026, we’re opening the
Children’s Zoo Farmyard
for Holiday Lights, our beloved holiday tradition. Enjoy a festive moment with donkeys, sheep, goats, alpacas, and more in this cozy, picture-perfect backdrop!
For more special animal moments and extra warm-up spots, we’re keeping the
World of Darkness
and
World of Reptiles
open too, so you can hang with a sloth and bask with lizards as part of your Bronx Zoo nighttime adventure.
For even more animal magic, your Holiday Lights tickets now offer a
2- in-1 experience!
Arrive at 1 p.m. to spend time with your favorite animals, including snow leopards, tigers, and bears, and stay for the lights.
The Best of New York City’s Family Holiday Tradition
During Holiday Lights, the Bronx Zoo transforms into a magical, forested wonderland filled with stunning animal lanterns, enchanting moments, and festive delights! Each year, this celebratory nighttime experience draws families from across the tri-state area and beyond to connect and make precious memories together. With entertainment, delicious treats, and activities for everyone, Holiday Lights is packed with festive fun! This year, we’re adding an extra sprinkle of animal magic to the mix.
GET TICKETS
WCS Member Benefits
A Celebration in Lights
Lantern
Safaris
Travel through six immersive trails representing Africa, Asia, North America, Latin America, the Ocean, and the Forest of Color, and see hundreds of glorious animal lanterns depicting iconic animals from each region. Feel connected to the wildlife and wild places that WCS is working to protect around the world.
Iconic Light
Displays
Perfect for incredible photo ops with friends and family.
Holiday Tree
At the heart of the zoo, our stunning holiday tree features synchronized animal-themed musical light performances.
Astor Court
Light Tunnels
Dazzling walk-through light tunnels throughout the zoo create perfect holiday photo backdrops.
Around the Park
More Holiday Lights fun!
Play with Light
Draw, touch, and dance with light at interactive glowing walls, shimmering flowers, and colored stepping stones. Send virtual holiday cards to WCS conservation staff worldwide.
Dancing Crane Plaza
Illuminated Performers
Amazing animal-themed illuminated characters amp up the atmosphere and add a fun, festive twist to family photo ops.
Astor Court
Holiday Train
All aboard! Take a joyful spin around Fountain Circle on the kids’ Holiday Train!
$4 ($3 Members, FREE for Conservation-level Members)
Fountain Circle
Freeze Zone
Take an exhilarating ride on a snowtube slide, throw virtual snowballs, and get a cool photo op in the interactive Freeze Zone!
Giraffe Corner
Ice Carving Demonstrations
Watch in awe as ice sculptors create works of wildlife art from giant blocks of ice!
Grizzly Corner
Wildlife Theater
Performers and puppets present you with family-friendly animal adventures and wildlife trivia.
Dancing Crane Pavilion
Holiday
Treats & Drinks
Dial up the holiday cheer with cozy festive treats available for purchase, including hot chocolate, warm apple cider, eggnog, cookies, peppermint bark, pumpkin pie, s’mores, and so much mores! Adults can warm things up by spiking their seasonal drink with Irish Cream, Kahlúa, Whiskey, or Rum.
Throughout the Zoo
Even more
2 for 1
Holiday Fun
Come for the animals, stay for the lights! Arrive at the zoo at 1pm, and your Holiday Lights tickets allow you to enjoy a few hours with your favorite animals before the lights go on and the park transforms!
GET TICKETS
WCS Member Benefits
Tickets are required and must be reserved in advance. Changes to activity availability may occur due to unforeseen conditions. Holiday Lights is a rain or shine event.

Host your very own holiday party at the Bronx Zoo during our Holiday Lights celebration. Perfect for groups of any size.
Learn More
2026: November 21–22 and 27–29. December 3–6, 10–13, 17–23, 26–31. 2027: January 2–3. (December 3 is a
Sensory Friendly Night
with some modifications of the experiences.)
Holiday Lights operates 1pm to 9pm. Last entry into the park is at 8pm.

Please note that the lights go on and lantern trails open at 4:30pm.

Bronx River and Southern Boulevard Gates are the ONLY gates open for Holiday Lights. Asia Gate and Fordham Road Gate are CLOSED for Holiday Lights. Asia Gate is closed for pedestrian exit at 2 pm.
Yes! We are pleased to offer a specific Sensory-Friendly Night on December 3, 2026 to provide an experience that is supportive of guests with sensory sensitivities. See details of program modifications on
the event page
, or contact

with additional questions.

Bronx Zoo accessibility webpage

records.description:
December 26–31, 2026 - 11am-3pm
Get Tickets
FREE with your Aquarium ticket or Membership
December 26–31, 2026 - 11am-3pm
Get Tickets
FREE with your Aquarium ticket or Membership
Seas & Greetings
Join us December 26 through 31 for New York Aquarium Holiday Tides, an all-new, fun-filled celebration with animals, entertainment, and seasonal experiences, all in one place and included with Aquarium admission. Holiday Tides features activities for your family to enjoy during winter break, including ice-carving demonstrations, seasonal storytelling & songs, crafts, and much more!
Holiday fun, Aquarium-style!
Enrichment Treats for Animals
This season, our aquarium animals receive their own “treats”! Watch as penguins and sea lions explore ice sculptures, and fish, otters, and other animals receive special food treats and other items to explore. Get an inside look at how enrichment activities encourage natural behavior in aquarium animals and support their well-being.
Ice-Carving Demonstrations
Watch skilled ice-carving artists transform massive blocks of ice into incredible creations, which will be used as enrichment items for the animals.
Seasonal Storytelling & Songs
Join Wildlife Theater for some wintery songs, stories, puppets, and fun!
Seasonal Crafts
Children get hands-on decorating their own ornament to take home with them. Plus, decorate a link in a paper chain to be gifted to the penguins for their behavioral enrichment!
Seasonal Treats
Indulge in limited-time, festive food and beverage offerings, including seasonal flatbreads, cinnamon buns, caramel apples, churros, zeppoles, and caramel corn!
4D Theater
Enjoy Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer 4D!* When an epic snowstorm threatens Christmas, can he rescue his family and friends and help Santa save the holiday?
Aquatheather
In our celebration, the bonds our sea lions have with their trainers take center stage.
Photo Opportunities and Holiday Decor
Festive decorations throughout the Aquarium provide the perfect backdrops to capture seasonal memories.
Get Tickets
Holiday Tides festivities are included with New York Aquarium admission or Membership. Let’s celebrate the season together with fun activities for all ages in the company of more than 4,500 incredible marine animals.
Check our
Know Before You Go Page
for the latest information on our current entry policies and procedures.
